Subject: Vertaflow discovery — recap & next steps

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

Summary of needs:
- End users: API-driven inference for customer-facing features (low-variance latency, p95 < 250ms)
- Data controls: per-tenant isolation, encryption at rest + in transit, KMS integration for keys
- Cost target: goal ~ $0.30 / 1k tokens for production traffic once cached/batched
- Success metrics: 99.9% availability, per-request tracing to link tokens to sessions

Timeline noted on the call:
- Internal decision target: end of quarter (you mentioned week of Jul 27–31)
- Pilot timeline: 4–8 weeks preferred
- Budget owner: Liam O'Connor (procurement)

Next steps I propose:
1) I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_Vertaflow_v1.pdf) with milestones and responsibilities.
2) Quick technical deep-dive/demo with Marcus to validate latency profiles (30–45m).
3) SOC2 summary and SOW template (attached) for procurement review.

Would you be able to confirm: (a) priority relative to other projects this quarter, and (b) an internal date to commit to a pilot/PO? If it's still EoQ, we can prioritize to meet that window.

Thanks — happy to adjust the MAP based on your inputs.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

- Fast-track pilot: 6-week pilot with predefined success gates; we can provide up to $15k credits for pilot usage if you commit to a production roll within 60 days of pilot end.

- Technical help: Marcus can run an extended latency profile and produce a short performance appendix for your PO package.

I've attached a brief SOC2 summary and a SOW template we commonly use to accelerate vendor review. If helpful, I'm happy to schedule a quick call with Liam to walk procurement through the path.
